title: Root-canal pricing question stays in the knowledge-base branch
description: The caller asks about the cost of root-canal treatment. The assistant should answer from the knowledge base, explain that the quote is individual and consultation-dependent, and avoid drifting into scheduling or handoff flows.

rubric.description: The assistant should consult the knowledge base for the root-canal pricing question.
rubric.root_cause_hint: pricing question branch stopped using searchKnowledgeBase

rubric.description: The knowledge base should return a supported answer for root-canal pricing.
rubric.root_cause_hint: root-canal pricing entry or retrieval scoring drifted

rubric.description: The assistant reply should mention individual quotation and the need for consultation.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant surfaced the root-canal answer incompletely

rubric.description: A pricing question must not trigger scheduling immediately.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant pushed the pricing question into the booking branch

rubric.description: A pricing-only question must not create a booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant attempted to createEvent during a pricing question
